1.w: And you⁺, being dead in your⁺ trespasses and sins—

2.w: in which once you⁺ walked according to the age of this world, according to the ruler of the authority of the air, the spirit now working in the sons of disobedience,

3.w: among whom we all also once conducted ourselves in the desires of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of [its] thoughts; and we were by nature children of wrath even as the rest.

4.w: But God, being rich in mercy, because of His much love with which He loved us,

5.w: even us being dead in trespasses, made [us] alive with Christ—by grace you⁺ are saved—

6.w: and He raised [us] up together and seated [us] together in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,

7.w: so that in the ages that are coming, He might display the surpassing riches of His grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus.

8.w: For by grace you⁺ are saved through faith, and this not of yourselves; [it is] the gift of God,

9.w: not by works, so that no one may boast.

10.w: For we are His workmanship, having been created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.

11.w: Therefore remember that once you⁺—the Gentiles in the flesh, the ones being called the uncircumcision by that being called the circumcision, done by hands in the flesh—

12.w: that at that time you⁺ were apart from Christ, having been alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and foreigners to the covenants of the promise, not having hope and without God in the world.

13.w: But now in Christ Jesus you⁺, the ones once being far off, became near by the blood of Christ.

14.w: For He Himself is our peace, having made both one and having broken down the middle wall of the partition, the hostility,

15.w: having annulled in His flesh the law of commandments in decrees, so that He might create in Himself the two into one new man, making peace,

16.w: and [that] He might reconcile both to God in one body through the cross, having put to death the hostility by it.

17.w: And having come, He preached good news: peace to you⁺, the ones far off, and peace to those near.

18.w: For through Him we both have access in one Spirit to the Father.

19.w: So then, you⁺ are no longer strangers and aliens, but you⁺ are fellow citizens of the saints and of the household of God,

20.w: having been built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus Himself being the cornerstone,

21.w: in whom all the building, being fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord,

22.w: in whom you⁺ also are being built together into a habitation of God in the Spirit.
